title: Cut the concrete P104 nonunit handoff from 140 to 22 gates (no new κ)
body:
Reduce #6297's concrete P104 handoff from 140 inserted gates / allowance 1,136 to 22 ADDs / allowance 280. Prove sharp source/cut minima of six/five ADDs, even with ancillary roles. A second verified tradeoff uses 26 ADDs / allowance 272. Both preserve the rank-9 to rank-5-plus-rank-4 split, full paid profile and dirty-input endpoint. No whole-word or weighted-allowance optimum is claimed.

#6297 source: 2fbb316a7bd34fabebed8e47ed40017c150d71b8. Exact live and retained-source pins: SOURCES.json and PREDECESSOR.json.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-unit-column-handoff
```

Executed: all four registered normal/optimized checks; separate integer-dyadic whole-word verification of 744 formal columns, every frame and eight owned lifetimes; 280 compiler fixtures and 2,500 support transitions. Missing gates, wrong charts, growth and ownership faults reject. The alternative adds 28 primary and ten independent semantic controls. Committed bytes/modes, official export and read-only Git-free replay pass; eight new exported corruptions reject. Original receipt is preserved verbatim. Deterministic constructions and domains; stop after the verified savings, no global search claim. Complete remote tree matches tested contents.

No new κ. This improves a historical local boundary module; the selected word has changed helper boundaries. Native/caller admission, compiler closure, stock/precision/tape and outer costs remain unrun or inherited; all five framework assumptions remain. No hosted CI, formal-kernel or complete-history preflight claimed. Open questions concern weighted optimality and complete supplier admission.
